general.colossalchests2.description: Chests that are quite colossal, and can be upgraded.

chest.colossalchests2.over_capacity: Over capacity slots: %s. They hold more than they can, so they only allow taking items out. This happens after re-forming a chest smaller or lowering capacity settings.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.none: This chest has no problems, it should form shortly.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.no_core: Not formed: no chest core. Replace one wall with a core of the same material.

chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.not_cube: Not formed: the walls span %sx%sx%s, but a chest must be a cube.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.too_smal: Not formed: a chest must be at least 2x2x2.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.too_larg: Not formed: %s blocks wide, but this material allows at most %s.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.blocks: Not formed. Missing walls: %s, other material: %s, blocks inside: %s (highlighted).

gui.colossalchests2.show_counts.info: If Display walls show item counts.
